purpose: 物品立绘（docs/WORLD_EXPANSION.md 2.8）。放到 target 路径即自动显示在行囊里（scripts/ui/art_library.gd 的 item_icon_path：物品自己的图 → 宝物按底材、玉简按神通类型的共用图 → 品类图）。tests/content_smoke.gd 报告覆盖数；九成以上后改为必查。
style: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent square item icon for 凡途, a 2D Chinese cultivation RPG, shown at about 40-96 px in lists and larger in item details. Create ONE object, 512x512, genuinely transparent background, centred, filling about 80% of the square with safe margins, slight three-quarter view. Style: original unmistakably 2D HAND DRAWN Chinese cultivation game art, crisp dark ink outlines, flat opaque muted jade, ivory, bronze and accent colours by the item's grade, restrained one or two cel shadow tones, economical large shapes readable when small. No text, labels, UI, border, frame, backdrop, floor, drop shadow, checkerboard, photorealism or 3D.
